title: Umami Crunchy Jamaican Vegetable Salad
description: A vegetarian-friendly Jamaican dish featuring raw and blanched vegetables, this salad is perfect for a weeknight dinner with its umami flavor and crunchy texture.
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and blanch the sliced zucchini for 2 minutes.
Immediately transfer the zucchini to an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
In a large bowl, combine the grated carrots, sliced red bell pepper, chopped green onions, and chopped scotch bonnet peppers.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, lime juice, and olive oil to make the dressing.
Add the dressing to the bowl with the vegetables and toss to combine.
Add the blanched zucchini to the bowl and toss again to combine.
Season the salad with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate the salad for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the salad a good stir and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
